Fix: own in-flight page to the conversation that started it
loadOlder() adds a `conversationIdRef` ownership check so a page that
resolves after the user switched conversations is dropped instead of being
merged into the new conversation's global event store.
Unit tests added (__tests__/hooks/use-load-older-events.test.tsx)
1) discards an older page that resolves after its conversation was switched away
2) rapid A→B→A switching does not double-merge pages from either side
Note on unit-test execution: this sandbox runs Node v24.1.0, where zustand@5 ESM
named `create` re-exports are ambiguous and every store-importing test (including
the pre-existing __tests__/stores/use-event-store.test.ts) fails with
`create(...) is not a function`. CI runs Node 24.15 (ci.yml), where these tests
pass. The two new tests mirror the identical mock/act patterns as the existing
passing tests in the same file, so they are covered by the `npm test` CI job.
Conventional commit: fix(hooks): drop stale load-older page when conversation switched (#16875)
